rows.en: ...........It's really windy today.{p}
I don't think I can stay up here very long.{p}

Oh well, I'll leave for now.
I left the nurse's office where she lay.
"Wait!"
Just as I was about to step out into the hallway, someone suddenly called to me from behind.{p}
Startled, I dropped the textbook I was holding.{p}
"Uwaagh☆"

Hashimoto let out a dull scream and tumbled down the stairs.
...I feel sorry for her, but there's nothing I can do.
Kawahara, that's cruel.
You didn't have to go and kill this girl...
As I was thinking that, a sudden headache hit me.
What's happening to me?
My head hurts like it's splitting open.
Ah..........{p}

......................Darkness swallowed everything around me.
And then Kawahara appeared before my eyes once more.{p}

"What the hell are you, anyway?"
What...?
Kawahara, why would you say something like that...?
"This isn't the outcome I wanted.
Well, fine. If that's how you want it, I'll show you something good.
You're doing a feature on the school's seven wonders, right?"
He was ranting at the top of his voice.
"I'll give you some great material.
First stop, the shoe lockers.
Not that you're going home, mind you.
We're going to go see Kazama.{p}

See, right here.
The one you looked inside a little while ago.
You figured there was nothing in here, didn't you?{p}But take another look.
You're sure to find something new."
Open the shoe locker
Don't open it
The instant I opened the shoe locker, something hard and slick came tumbling out.{p}

Drops of something spattered onto my face.
A sourish smell.{p}

It was Kazama's head.
It can't be...
It was so horrible that my body wouldn't move the way I wanted.
Even so, I managed to shift my gaze, and I could see what had tumbled out of the shoe locker.
...A severed hand.
On reflex, I slammed the shoe locker shut.
The impact seemed to have jostled what was inside.{p}
Something thudded against the inside of the locker door.{p}

"He opened this door and saw the textbook.
He must've read the love letter tucked inside it, too.
What an idiot, huh? Getting all wrapped up in a letter like that, getting left behind by everyone, and ending up like this."
...What?
After Kazama stayed behind at the shoe lockers, he came back to the club room just fine, didn't he?
Why is this person saying these things?
"Let's move on."
He started walking again.
What on earth is this path?
Darkness, and a faint glimmer of light.
We aren't walking through the school, and yet we end up at places like the shoe lockers.{p}

Before I knew it, I was standing beside the cart in the old school building.
He spoke up again.{p}"Don't you think Akemi Iwashita is kind of a nasty piece of work?"
Yes, I do
No, I don't
I don't really know

"Dodging the question, huh?
Me, I figured that woman was seriously bad news."
His tone grew rougher and rougher.
"She was the type who says whatever's on her mind, wasn't she?{p}

The total opposite of me.
I didn't like her, so I fed her to the wheels.{p}

Aw, this cart's already hauling plenty of corpses as it is.
One or two more bodies won't matter. It'll carry them all the way down to hell, no problem."{p}

Long hair was caked onto the wheels.
And scraps of flesh.
I could see mushy, oozing meat, as if a scalp had been peeled off.
There was no sign of Iwashita.{p}

"Let's go."
And once again, the darkness swallowed us.{p}

The next place we came to was the gym.
The exit slammed shut with a loud bang.
"You got locked in like this earlier too, right?
Just you and Shindo, all alone.
That was me."
I could hear his voice.
But he was nowhere to be seen.
"Shindo mistook me for Tadokoro, the idiot.
It was funny, so I kept my mouth shut."
He appeared and pointed at the basketball hoop.{p}

"You get it by now, right? The ones you were talking to until a little while ago were ghosts.
...I killed them."
He was grinning.
What does that mean?
Are you saying everyone was killed after they saw the textbook?
Hosoda, and Arai too...?
"You know where we're headed next, right?"
He gripped my hand hard.
"...The restroom?"
There was no answer.
He silently led me on to the next place.{p}

After walking for a while, we reached the restroom I had gone into with Hosoda today.
"That stall there... Want to take a peek?"
His back was trembling.
As if he were heaving for breath.{p}Is he laughing?
Or is he just excited?
Look in the stall
Don't look

"I've had enough.
Hosoda's been killed in here too, hasn't he? I know it."
I refused him flatly.
"Don't be like that."{p}

A hand came to rest on my shoulder from behind.
...?
A big, fleshy hand, too soft and springy to be his.
This is...{p}

"Eek...!"
A huge mass came toppling down onto me.
Hosoda★
"Ee, eek... ee...☆"
My voice wouldn't come out.
Even so, I somehow managed to dodge aside.
Hosoda collapsed limply onto the floor.
...That's not how a living person falls.{p}

"I killed this one too."
The man in front of me said it quietly.
"Are you the ghost of the man who appeared in the restroom?"
"...No."
"Then you weren't the one who possessed Hosoda in the restroom?"
"How should I know?
You all tried to turn it into newspaper material just for kicks, so some ghost or other got angry, I guess."{p}
He took my hand and led me off again.{p}

...The next place we came to was the audiovisual room.
On a desk near the entrance lay a single 8mm tape.
"Arai's dead inside this thing.
He told you, didn't he? That next it was your turn to be killed by this video.{p}I wonder if that'll really happen?"
I suppose it will
Don't joke about this!
Please, help me
Not a chance.{p}

You couldn't save Hashimoto.
Worse than that, you just stood there in silence and watched her try to kill herself.
Kazama, Iwashita, Shindo, Hosoda, Arai, Fukuzawa... they were all the same.
They treat other people's suffering like it's none of their business.
That's why I killed them.
I wanted them to taste the same pain. The pain called death.
This is to make an example of them.
I killed them.
Right on the stages of the ghost stories they told.
What's the matter?
You're shaking.{p}

Heh heh, I'll kill you too.
Together with Fukuzawa, in the reflection room.
Or would you rather follow Arai?
You were supposed to be killed by the Mummy Man in the video, weren't you?
Hahahahaha, hahahahahaha.........{p}

For an instant, a strong wind blew.
As if swept away by it, the darkness that had covered everything around me faded.{p}

And I was back in the reflection room.
Kazama and the others were already gone.
Had they really been killed?
...There was a raw, fishy smell.
Like a fish that had been gutted.
No, a nastier smell than that.
Come to think of it, I'd heard that cutting open a human belly makes a horrible stink.
That's why medical students nearly faint during surgery practice and such...
Thinking about things like that, I turned around.{p}

...It's Fukuzawa.
She had collapsed, slumped against the wall.
Her face and body were drenched in blood.
It was hard to tell with all the blood soaking her uniform, but judging by this smell, her belly must have been split wide open.{p}The next instant, the shelf lurched and tipped over.{p}
My head sent up a spray of blood even bigger than Fukuzawa's belly had...{p}

"No, you don't. You're going to look inside."
The moment he said it, an invisible force moved my hand and opened the shoe locker door.{p}
That instant, something hard and slick came tumbling out.{p}

"Right?
She seems like the type who says whatever's on her mind, doesn't she?{p}

"I see.
Doesn't matter what you think.
I didn't like her from the moment I first laid eyes on her.
She seems like the type who says whatever's on her mind, doesn't she?{p}

"Naive."
It was Kawahara's voice.{p}
That's right, this is no joke.{p}
"Hashimoto, if something's troubling you, tell me."{p}

...There's surely nothing I can do.
What's already happened can't be undone anyway.
This is between the two of them.
"Sorry for bothering you."
I left.{p}
And then the darkness closed in all around.{p}

...When I came to, I was standing in the reflection room.
The people who had told me about the seven wonders were gone.
What day is it today?
For now, I decided to go back to the club room.
If I'm back on the day of the seven wonders meeting, the club room should be set up for it.{p}

Through the windows along the hallway, I could see the dark sky.
What a horrible night.{p}

...When I got back to the club room, Hino was there.
"Hino?"
"{a}?
What happened to you?
That was low, skipping out on the seven wonders meeting."
"What?"
"You didn't show, so the members I gathered griped at me.
I had to run the meeting myself in your place, you know."
"But... I heard stories from six people."
"Don't lie to me.
Or what, did a tanuki play a trick on you?"
Then what on earth were the stories I heard?
And those six people?
"Hino, the members you gathered..."
"All third-years, from my class.
Let's see, Hongo, Mori, Tanaka, Hayashi..."
Every one of them was a name I didn't know.
If what Hino said was true, then what on earth had I been seeing?{p}

I went back to the reflection room once more.
"...Oh."
My watch was lying in a corner of the reflection room floor.
It's the one I dropped while trying to tidy up the club room before Fukuzawa told her story.
Could it be that while I thought I was in the club room, I had really been summoned to this reflection room?
Was it all set up by Kawahara?
Kazama, Iwashita, Shindo, Hosoda, Arai, Fukuzawa...
Were they all illusions Kawahara showed me?
Or maybe they, too, were people who had died for some reason.{p}

I went back to the newspaper club room again.
I really have to write this feature myself.
I told Hino how Kawahara's power had drawn me into the reflection room and how I'd been through something strange.
And somehow I talked him around, and it was decided that I would see this project through to the end.{p}
The next day, I went to the reflection room.{p}

"It can't be helped anymore.
Kawahara's dead, after all.{p}

"That's right.
Kawahara's dead, after all.{p}

"Why are you giving me orders?
Don't act so high and mighty.{p}

Anyway, I did something terrible to Kawahara.
So I don't deserve to live."{p}

"Hashimoto, stop!"
I shouted before I could stop myself.
But she wouldn't stop writing.
"Hashimoto!"
Can't my voice reach her?
The moment I tried to go to her, I was engulfed in a blinding light.{p}
